# sorobeacon Provider

Manage SoroBeacon monitors, rules and channels as code.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) SoroBeacon API base URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080/api/v1).

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) API bearer token. Required when API_TOKEN is set on the instance.
